text: The figures show revenue of 6,455 million growing at 27.6 % annually since FY22, a solid 18.9 % EBITDA margin and an 18 % ROE, which support the bullish narrative of strong top‑line and profitability growth. However, the 28.4 % decline in PAT year‑on‑year for Q2FY27 and the current EBITDA margin of 15.8 % falling short of the 20 % guidance temper that optimism.
